description: This file defines a Next.js page component for editing a note. It fetches the note data and list of notes asynchronously, and renders a user interface with components like AppHeader, Sidebar, and NoteEditor. It includes a server-side handler for saving updated note data.

methods.name: EditNotePage
methods.description: Asynchronous React component that fetches note data and renders the editing interface.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving updated note data by calling the updateNote API.
